full_judgment: 12. Before taking any action under Order XXI, rule 32 of the Code of Civil Procedure against the delinquent the Court must be satisfied that the judgment-debtor has willfully disobeyed or violated the Court's order of injunction. An enquiry on the allegations of wilful disobedience or violation of injunction by the judgment-debtors is therefore essential before taking any positive action against the delinquent. The Court shall not act mechanically and blindly to punish a judgment-debtor without affording him any opportunity of being heard. Further a Court of law cannot punish anybody with- out being satisfied to the effect that the judgment- debtor has wilfully disobeyed or violated the decree/ order of injunction. We find support of the above view in the case of Jiban Bima Corporation vs Mahibul Majid, reported in 52 DLR 186.
